oracle.description: For two trial rows with equal selection and treatment probabilities, normalized Dirichlet(1,1) row mass U is Uniform(0,1); the transported effect draw is 8U-2.
oracle.formula: U ~ Beta(1,1); effect draw = 8 U - 2; mean = 8/2 - 2 = 2; variance = 64 (1/3 - 1/4) = 16/3.
context_only_outputs: the two-row trial design, which lives in the test
oracle.independence_basis: The generator uses only the Beta(1,1) moments and the linear map 8U - 2 stated in the fixture; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated map from row mass to the effect draw.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.
